report.mission: Extend the GridEngine to support long-running autonomous research threads that behave like autoresearch agents iterating on better synthesis strategies, damage detectors, proposal generators, daily_consolidation methods while the Conductor is offline or focused elsewhere. All in pure AgentDrive language on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive.

deliverables.code_extensions: GridEngine now hosts persistent research threads as durable background jobs (research_thread phase under DurableJobSupervisor with lease/heartbeat support for hours/days). Added Research Constitution discovery + iteration runner with fixed budgets, branch advancement via propose_experience_evolution (forked living-experience / specialized consolidation lineages), high-signal gating, bidirectional HealingFactor integration (threads trigger regeneration; HealingFactor spawns/consults threads via form_research_org_thread + research constitutions), and experience layer surfacing (high-signal observations as experience-observation page_type, research-thread subtype, daily-present eligible, queryable via Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True)).
example_research_thread_constitutions: research-thread-constitution-damage-detector-evolver@stabilization-wave-20260531.json (governs detector evolution + HealingFactor handoff + specialized consolidation lineages)
deliverables.signed_experience_observation_report: This artifact (autonomous-research-thread-swarm-experience-observation@stabilization-wave-20260531) — the authoritative signed report of the swarm's stabilization contributions, fully ingestible, fusion_checkpointed, and referenced by sibling swarms.
deliverables.coordination_artifacts: All constitutions + this observation placed in genomes/examples/ for immediate ingest into stabilization-wave-20260531 drive (or any live drive) via Drive.ingest, registry, bootstrap, reconcile, or daily_consolidation. Reference in fusion_checkpoints and KG research_branch / research_handoff / healed_by edges.

implementation_details.GridEngine: Extended GridConfig with enable_research_threads, research_thread_interval_s, max_concurrent_research_threads, research_budget_default. Added coordinator loop launching durable research_thread jobs. form_autonomous_research_thread surface preserved/enhanced for Multi-Agent Research Org handoff. All logs use stabilization-wave-20260531 context + CID.
implementation_details.HealingFactor_integration: Bidirectional: research threads call/emit to HealingFactor for regeneration on high-signal; HealingFactor form_research_org_thread + _diagnose/_generate now consult research-constitutions and spawn research threads. Uses ResearchBudget + MultiMetricEvaluationHarness from Constrained Evolutionary Search Swarm sibling.
implementation_details.experience_layer: Research threads only surface high-signal as experience-observations (with research_thread_id, branch_advance, fusion_checkpoint, healing_integration). Discoverable as daily-present or research-thread observations. Constitutions themselves (research-constitution page_type) are first-class queryable artifacts per schema pack.
implementation_details.durable_jobs: Uses existing DurableJobSupervisor submit_queued_dream(phase='research_thread' | 'research-org') with long leases, heartbeat keeper, jittered backoff, hierarchy, auto-attributed ingest for provenance. Supports unattended execution for hours/days.
implementation_details.research_branches: High-signal iterations advance via propose_experience_evolution producing forked living-experience genomes or specialized consolidation lineage updates. Only high-signal cross promotion/ingest threshold.
implementation_details.publication_clean: All changes targeted edits to grid/engine.py + new genomes/examples/ JSONs (no new .py modules, no unrelated files, pure AgentDrive terminology throughout: experience layer, HealingFactor, DurableJobSupervisor, research-constitution, living-experience forks, daily_consolidation, stabilization-wave-20260531 drive, role-swarm coherence).

report.status: Mission fulfilled. Full autoresearch integration live in GridEngine for real-time Grid. Persistent research threads governed by Research Constitutions now run autonomously, coordinate with HealingFactor, advance branches, surface high-signal only via experience layer. Ready for ingest + Conductor use on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive and production.
